note: DISPLAY-ONLY settings for the Unity visualisation layer. None of these values is a model, controller or clinical parameter. They decide only what the UI draws.

flag_p_outlier_display.purpose: Show a 'Possible artefact' flag when P_outlier >= this value (display only)

flag_p_level_shift_display.purpose: Show a 'Possible level shift' flag when P_level_shift >= this value (display only)

history_window_min.purpose: Rolling history shown in the thermal panel (plan section 4J)

forecast_window_min.purpose: Forecast region width (longest horizon, plan section 4K)

y_axis_min_span_degC.purpose: Minimum vertical span of the thermal panel (layout only)

trend_deadband_degC.purpose: Telemetry trend arrows show 'steady' when the 60 s change is within this band (display only)

module_label_offset_m.purpose: Height of the floating module chips above each module (layout only)
